existing_authority.interpretation: All genuine Nissor 1906 headwords are already approved for historical lexical inclusion. That source-wide approval does not certify modern spelling, meaning, POS, register, borrowing status, or present-day usage.

preservation_rules: Retain each genuine Nissor 1906 headword as historical lexical evidence under the existing source-wide owner approval.

Do not infer current use, obsolescence, or archaic status from absence in the licensed current corpus.
Preserve historical POS and glosses as source evidence, not as automatically verified modern analysis.
Preserve semantic-split flags and historical borrowing/foreign-source flags for later review.
Do not promote any Tier-6 record to current_attested or final verified status solely from this disposition.
This disposition applies only to the exact 2518-record Tier-6 set identified by the pinned hashes above; changed membership requires a new decision.
owner_note: Tier 6 is handled differently from Tiers 1-5 because these records have historical evidence only and no modern/current attestation.
